listitem.para: Trace ON. Takes a boolean argument. If true, enables full code tracing. The trace will be displayed in the system log such as systemd's journal. Defaults to false.

Takes a string argument. With this you can specify whether IPv4, IPv6, or both are supported when connecting to a Controller. Connections will not be attempted to IP addresses (whether discovered or configured in the connectivity configuration) disabled by this option. If an invalid value is entered, then the default (see below) will apply.
Choices are ipv4, ipv6, or ipv4+ipv6.
